[To [Anne Yonge](../persons.html#1582)]At the Hall[^1] is a beautiful picture of [King Charles](../persons.html#1768) the martyr, a full-length, and with the beautiful forehead we always see him drawn with.

[^1]: West Dean, near Chichester, Sussex, where they were staying with CMY’s godmother [Caroline Vernon Harcourt](../persons.html#1422), sister of its owner, Lord Selsey.
